project.name: AtelierOS
project.tagline: The High-Precision Operating System for Modern Automotive Workshops

target_regions.e_invoicing_standard: Factur-X (CII / UBL 2.1) via Approved PDP (Pennylane) & Chorus Pro (PPF)
Swiss QR-Bill (Structured BVR with 27-digit reference + QR-IBAN)
target_regions.regulatory_framework: Federal Tax Administration (ESTV), Swiss nLPD (Data Protection)

core_architectural_principles.description: A unified availability and scheduling pipeline shared across garage desktop admin, mechanic tablet stations, customer web booking, and AutoAI receptionists, guaranteeing 0 double bookings and 0 bay conflicts.

core_architectural_principles.principle: Internal Invoicing vs Pluggable PDP Transmission
core_architectural_principles.description: AtelierOS is the internal invoicing engine (calculating parts, labor, deterministic multi-country VAT, PDF and Factur-X generation). External transmission to the French tax administration is handled via a provider-neutral pluggable connector (Pennylane PDP, Chorus Pro) so staff never leave the application.
Dynamic customer profiling supporting French, Swiss, and cross-border customers with deterministic tax rate calculations and native dual-currency (EUR € / CHF CHF) invoicing.
Complete data separation across garage tenants using Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) with zero cross-tenant leakage.

core_architectural_principles.principle: Bounded AI with Strict Function Calling
core_architectural_principles.description: OpenAI LLM integration operates exclusively through strictly typed JSON tool calling (checking real garage availability, quoting estimate matrix, looking up OBD-II codes) without hallucinations.

user_roles_and_workspaces.label: Vehicle Owner (Customer Portal)
access: Magic Link Quote Inspection & Digital Signature

scheduling_engine.name: Central Scheduling & Bay Constraint Engine
scheduling_engine.description: Deterministic resource scheduler enforcing mechanic skill matrix, bay lift weight specs, and automatic 15-minute cleaning/reset buffers.
features: Bay types: 2-Post Lift, 4-Post Alignment Lift, Diagnostics Bay, Fast-Lube Bay
Mechanic skill verification (Brakes, Engine, Diagnostics, EV/Hybrid, Transmission, Tires, AC)
Temporary 10-minute slot holding for customer web bookings
Automated conflict prevention and real-time alternative slot suggestions

work_order_pipeline.name: 10-Stage Visual Work Order Kanban
mechanic_tablet_features: 48px minimum touch target size for grease-resistant operation
Direct OBD-II DTC database lookup with severity rating and suggested repair steps
Digital safety checklist (Brakes, Tires, Fluids, Lights, Battery)

quote_and_approval_portal.name: Magic Link Quotation & Digital Approval Portal
quote_and_approval_portal.description: Zero-friction customer quote review dispatched via SMS/WhatsApp/Email.
features: Instant magic-link access with cryptographic token authentication
Itemized parts and labor breakdown with VAT transparency
Digital canvas and typed authorization signature capture
Real-time status callback notifying workshop supervisor in < 3 minutes
Automatic transition from Stage 5 (AWAITING_APPROVAL) to Stage 6 (APPROVED)

invoicing_and_cross_border_billing.name: Invoicing Engine & Pluggable PDP/PPF E-Invoicing Connector
invoicing_and_cross_border_billing.description: Deterministic cross-border billing engine for France & Switzerland with pluggable electronic transmission.
e_invoice_lifecycle: SUBMITTED (Transmise à la PDP / Chorus Pro)

auto_ai_assistant.name: AutoAI Workshop Receptionist & Technical Intake

Direct intake dispatch creating customer work order drafts

email_automation.purpose: Transactional emails (Booking confirmations, Magic link quote approvals, Factur-X PDF invoices, 24h appointment reminders)
email_automation.integration_method: Brevo REST API v3 / SMTP Relay

estimated_monthly_charges.cost_eur: €0 (Up to 300 emails/day) or €19/month (Starter up to 20,000 emails/month)
estimated_monthly_charges.notes: Generous free tier completely covers single garage pilot. €19/mo supports multi-garage scaling.

whatsapp_and_sms_notifications.provider: WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta) & Brevo SMS / Twilio
whatsapp_and_sms_notifications.purpose: Direct SMS & WhatsApp message delivery for instant quote approvals and vehicle ready pick-up notifications
whatsapp_and_sms_notifications.integration_method: Meta Graph API (Cloud API v19.0) & Brevo SMS API

estimated_monthly_charges.whatsapp_cost: First 1,000 service conversations/month FREE per Meta Business account. Thereafter ~€0.035 per utility message in France.
estimated_monthly_charges.sms_cost: Pay-as-you-go ~€0.045 per SMS in France, ~0.08 CHF in Switzerland.
estimated_monthly_charges.estimated_total_eur: €5 - €25 / month per active garage based on volume.

ai_engine.purpose: AutoAI workshop receptionist, natural language symptom intake, OBD-II diagnostic suggestions, and structured function calling
ai_engine.model_recommended: gpt-4o-mini (for fast 12ms intake) + gpt-4o (for complex diagnostic interpretation)
ai_engine.integration_method: OpenAI Chat Completions API with tools / tool_choice: auto

database_and_backend.purpose: Relational data storage, Row Level Security (RLS) multi-tenant isolation, Realtime WebSocket subscriptions for live bay boards, Auth, and Storage for vehicle damage photos & Factur-X XML
database_and_backend.integration_method: Supabase JS SDK (@supabase/supabase-js) + PostgreSQL RLS policies

estimated_monthly_charges.tier: Free Tier (Up to 500MB DB, 1GB File Storage, 50,000 MAU) or Pro Tier ($25/month / €23/month)
estimated_monthly_charges.notes: Free tier covers MVP and single garage pilot. Pro tier (€23/mo) includes automatic daily backups, 8GB DB, and point-in-time recovery for production.

frontend_and_edge_hosting.purpose: Serverless edge hosting, global CDN, automatic CI/CD deployment from GitHub repository, SSL/TLS, and custom domain routing
frontend_and_edge_hosting.integration_method: Vercel Git Integration (Next.js / Vite build pipeline)

estimated_monthly_charges.tier: Hobby Tier: €0/month (Commercial non-enterprise) or Pro Tier: $20/month (~€18.50/month per team member)
estimated_monthly_charges.notes: Hobby tier provides unlimited deployments with 100GB bandwidth. Pro tier recommended for custom SLA and multi-developer team.

approved_french_e_invoicing_platform.provider: Pennylane (Officially Approved French PDP) / Chorus Pro (B2G)
approved_french_e_invoicing_platform.purpose: Regulatory e-invoicing transmission to the DGFiP and French PDP interoperability network
approved_french_e_invoicing_platform.integration_method: Pennylane Company API v2 / Chorus Pro PISTE OAuth2

estimated_monthly_charges.pennylane_plan: Pennylane API partner pricing or client's existing Pennylane garage accounting subscription (typically €49 - €99/mo including accounting)
estimated_monthly_charges.chorus_pro_cost: 100% Free (French state-funded B2G platform via PISTE)
estimated_monthly_charges.notes: The garage pays for their own PDP subscription directly; AtelierOS connects via our pluggable connector at zero additional software surcharge.

production_multi_garage_stage.total_estimated_monthly_cost: €100.50 / month for up to 10 active garage tenants (~€10/garage/mo)
